note: How directly the room's sound (show_service's features) drives the per-item mappings. Hot-reloaded (stream_service/music_feed.py Response); a bad value keeps its default, an unknown key is listed in /inputs music_response.errors. Only while the features arrive; without them nothing here applies.

section_follow.note: regional_min_ease_s is binding.parse_v2's floor for live on a regional param; latched_bindings are <kind>/<item>/<param> whose review says they must hold for the section

beat_fallback.note: a pulse when onset / max(gate, gate_floor) >= max(floor, min(onset, relative x its mean over mean_s)); relative 0: onset alone. Off: an arrival-timed onset lands a whole render->photon lead (~0.6-0.8 s) late on glass; the predicted beat ladder (below) replaces it and wins when both are on. The same thresholds pick the onsets that feed the ladder's onset follower (every strong rising onset: min_gap_s paces this pulse only)

ladder.note: the bindings' beat (and the pulse macros) from one source at the frame's photon time: the clock at gate beat; else the desk follower locked and extrapolating; else the clock at gate dmx, its beat phase as a pulse dmx_depth deep; else, while the tempo is clear (clock stability >= stability_min, folded bpm within steady_pct % over steady_s), the onset follower (strong onsets at their acoustic time less onset_lag_ms, its period held to the clock's) once locked, onset_depth deep; else no pulse. Every pulse x music present (features.energy / present_at, capped at 1; instant on, letting go with tau release_s, and once features stop). Depths of 0.5 or less never cross the GLSL effects' event threshold (pulse > 0.5), 0.6 only on a frame within ~33 ms of the beat: an unsure phase fires few or no discrete events. Cuts keep the sure clock only. Wins over beat_fallback when both are on

pivot.note: each listed level centres on its own norm: the running median of its values while music plays (1 Hz, only while the bindings' energy >= present_at; held while silent or n/a) over window_s, applied once there are min_s of them (before that the fixed 0.5); the signal the bindings read is re-centred on it, eased in and out with tau ease_s. Never triggers, phases or DMX positions
